nodes.title: CLIP Text Encode (Positive Prompt)
widgets_values: Ultra-realistic close-up portrait of a 20-year-old young woman with long, wavy red hair cascading over her shoulders, each strand catching the light with vivid copper and auburn tones. The shot captures her from just above the eyebrows to below the chin, filling the frame with her face. Her pale, freckled skin is rendered in extreme detail, with visible pores, fine facial hairs, and subtle texture variations. Her green eyes shimmer with intricate iris detail, reflecting soft window light. The lighting is natural and diffused, creating gentle shadows that define the contours of her cheekbones, nose, and jawline. She wears minimal makeup—only a hint of mascara and a soft nude lip—allowing her natural beauty to stand out. The depth of field is razor-thin, keeping her eyes and skin texture perfectly sharp while the background melts into a smooth, blurred gradient. The mood is intimate and calm, as if she is lost in thought. The high-resolution detail should reveal micro-reflections in her eyes, the natural texture of her lips, and the way light plays across each hair strand. Shot with a Canon EOS R5 and a 100mm f/2.8 macro lens, 8K resolution, cinematic color grading.

nodes.title: Positive Prompt
widgets_values:
A captivating woman with a playful and alluring presence, standing confidently in what appears to be a laboratory or cosmetic setting. She has a striking appearance, featuring vibrant pink and yellow-streaked hair styled in playful space buns. She is dressed in a black lace bodysuit with intricate detailing, complemented by a black choker necklace with a gold ring detail. A wide black belt cinches her waist, and she wears thigh-high black boots with garter straps.

The background features shelves filled with colorful liquids in various containers, adding to the quirky and slightly unconventional setting. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the vivid colors and details of the scene. Her expression is flirtatious and inviting, with a slight pout and direct gaze. The overall composition is eye-catching and bold, blending elements of fashion, beauty, and a hint of scientific curiosity.

She wears a sheer pink lace babydoll with a ribbon at the front, and matching pink lace panties. Her small breasts are partially visible through the delicate fabric. The bed has white sheets, a pink floral blanket, and decorative pillows in blue and white. The background is a plain, light-colored wall. The overall mood is intimate and serene.
